Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to extract the director's death date from the Wikipedia page visible in the search results for "The Hidden One" (La Escondida, 1956). The page clearly listed the director as Roberto Gavaldón, who died in 1982. However, the WebSurfer did not capture this fact, instead continuing to search for the death date in subsequent steps without noting the available information. This omission led to an inability to compare the death dates of Don Sharp (2011) and Roberto Gavaldón (1982), resulting in the failure to correctly identify that the director of The Hidden One died first.
